contracts.new_listing_policy: Massive grouped daily discovers new securities; Massive flow and FMP profiles discover new ETFs; Oracle refreshes missing constituent snapshots first

contracts.on_demand_policy: explicit symbols bypass daily capacity selection but must pass the same packet and model gates
contracts.natural_request_policy: action=ask accepts a bounded question, runs fresh trained-model inference for explicit tickers, and answers market, candidate, or rotation requests only from the latest Oracle-date-matched green AI Radar report
